description: Find Google Images results with thumbnails, source URLs and dimensions. Use for image discovery; for web pages use google_search. Required: query. Verify image rights before reuse.

country.description: Two-letter search country code; default us. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

domain.description: Google search domain; default google.com. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

image_color.description: Color filter such as bw, trans, red, blue or white; omitted means any color. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

image_type.description: Image type: face, photo, clipart, lineart or animated; omitted means any type. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

imgar.description: Aspect ratio: s (square), t (tall), w (wide), xw (panoramic); omitted means any. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

imgsz.description: Image size such as l, m, i, vga or 2mp; omitted means any size. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

language.description: Result language code; default en. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

licenses.description: License filter: f, fc, fm, fmc, cl or ol; verify rights with the source before reuse. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

page.description: Zero-based results page, integer at least 0; default 0. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

query.description: Required Google Images search keywords; no default. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

safe.description: Adult-content filter: active or off; default off. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

tbs.description: Advanced Google Images filter expression copied from a search URL; omitted means no filter. No option surcharge; 10 credits per successful request.

name: google_images
title: Google Images search results
